title: SDDP Configuration
description: Configuration parameters for SDDP algorithm execution

num_forward_passes.description: Number of forward passes per iteration for Monte Carlo sampling

num_simulation_scenarios.description: Number of scenarios for out-of-sample simulation. Set to null or omit to skip simulation (training-only mode).

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility (any unsigned 64-bit integer)

num_threads.description: Number of threads for parallel execution. If null or omitted, auto-detects available cores. Recommended: 4 for small problems, 8-16 for large problems. Avoid over-subscription (threads > physical cores).

output_path.description: Optional path for CSV output files. If null or omitted, no output is generated (faster execution, useful for tests)
